description: Portable Hotline visual-shell registry. Shells control presentation; character profiles define identity, continuity and source authority. Betting Edge remains authoritative for report-driven betting decisions, while source-specific products such as Muddy Numbers may declare another authoritative data source.

rules.normalUpdate: REFRESH THE EDITION; PRESERVE THE PAGE.
rules.shellChange: A deliberate visual redesign creates a new shell package/version. Normal Hotline updates must not rewrite an approved shell.
rules.archive: Archived Hotline editions remain immutable and retain the shell/version used when issued.
rules.portability: Shell packages are designed to be installable independently of characters so future free or paid shell packs can be added without replacing character identity or continuity.
